document_title: Pinnacle, RealPage and a rent recommended overnight
_note: Built from render_report.json's own text nodes rather than retyped, because the strings a reader receives are the ones the browser laid out. The screen on frame 2 and the page on frame 6 are drawn on canvases as bars, bands and ruled lines and carry no words.
caption:
Frisco is in this case two ways.

The complaint and the Justice Department's impact statement place Pinnacle Property Management Services there. Appendix A of the complaint lists Frisco as a market where it says aligned pricing harmed or is likely to harm renters.

Pinnacle licensed RealPage's AI Revenue Management. The complaint says it recommends a new price for every floor plan every night.

The proposed judgment isn't a ban on RealPage. What it cuts off is the data. Starting 180 days after the court enters its stipulation order, Pinnacle can't use pricing software fed by third-party nonpublic data or pooled across owners. It binds one landlord.

Comments go to the Justice Department's Antitrust Division within 60 days of the September 18th notice.

Should rivals' data be the line for every pricing algorithm in Texas, or only for one Frisco landlord?

#FriscoTX #RealPage #TunneyAct

S1.headline: Rent, recommended overnight
S1.cite: c3 c12 c13 c20 c26 DRAWN
S1.body: The Justice Department has proposed a judgment against Pinnacle, an apartment manager the complaint places in Frisco. The complaint says Pinnacle's RealPage software recommends a new price for every floor plan every night.
strings: The Justice Department has proposed a judgment against Pinnacle, an apartment manager the complaint places in Frisco. The complaint says Pinnacle's RealPage software recommends a new price for every floor plan every night.

S2.headline: Yes in bulk, no with a reason
S2.body: A manager can accept in bulk and must give "specific business commentary" to decline, the complaint says. Across landlords nationally, it puts nearly 60% of final floor plan prices within 2.5% of RealPage's recommendation and more than 85% within 5%.
strings: Yes in bulk, no with a reason

A manager can accept in bulk and must give "specific business commentary" to decline, the complaint says. Across landlords nationally, it puts nearly 60% of final floor plan prices within 2.5% of RealPage's recommendation and more than 85% within 5%.

S3.headline: 3% a day, 8% a week
S3.cite: c27 c28 c29 DRAWN TO ONE SCALE
S3.body: The complaint says AIRM and YieldStar can accept recommendations automatically, and the default limits are 3% a day and 8% a week. It says a landlord who turns auto-accept on in effect hands pricing authority to RealPage inside those limits.
strings: The complaint says AIRM and YieldStar can accept recommendations automatically, and the default limits are 3% a day and 8% a week. It says a landlord who turns auto-accept on in effect hands pricing authority to RealPage inside those limits.
c27 c28 c29 DRAWN TO ONE SCALE

S4.headline: Leases feed the model
S4.body: The complaint says landlords' nonpublic lease data runs through a machine learning model whose learned parameters serve every AIRM client. It says the model is generally retrained three to four times a year. It says RealPage has data from over 16 million units.
strings: The complaint says landlords' nonpublic lease data runs through a machine learning model whose learned parameters serve every AIRM client. It says the model is generally retrained three to four times a year. It says RealPage has data from over 16 million units.

S5.headline: 48 Texas submarkets
S5.body: The complaint lists them as places where it says aligned pricing harmed or is likely to harm renters. Frisco and Richardson are on the list. RealPage has its headquarters in Richardson.
strings: The complaint lists them as places where it says aligned pricing harmed or is likely to harm renters. Frisco and Richardson are on the list. RealPage has its headquarters in Richardson.

S6.headline: Nine terms for Pinnacle
S6.cite: c3 c12 c39 to c48 DRAWN
S6.body: The impact statement sums up the proposed judgment against Pinnacle in nine terms. Beside the data limits they require a compliance officer, an annual audit and inspections.
labels: v. a chief antitrust compliance officer
ix. a monitor if the Court finds that Pinnacle has violated the terms

S8.cite: c55 c56 c58 c59 c36 DRAWN
